firstMessage.rawMarkdown:
Hi everyone, I’m starting from the public NVARC baseline and wondering how well local validation scores match the public LB.
Since the public LB only uses half of the test data, I’d rather focus on solid local improvements than chase leaderboard gains.
Have you found that improvements locally usually carry over to the LB, or has it been pretty hit-or-miss?🧐
